_comment: Class starter kits (design/gdd/race-gear-sets.md Part A 3.2-3.3, Boss 2026-11-13). Every class card starts wearing these catalog items at tier 'tier' (white). logic/profile.gd: new players get the kit; old saves get it once (starter_kit_version 2) in EMPTY slots only, and a worn weapon the class can no longer hold goes to the stash. The offhand round_shield stays with ensure_starter_shields. Accessories start empty. A class missing here gets no kit (data test warns).
_race_kit: Boss 2026-11-13: a card starts in its OWN race's starter outfit for its class (white race set pieces: weapon + 4 armour). logic/profile.gd uses race_kit.item when the catalog has it, else the kit's class piece. Old saves: empty slots only, once (starter_kit_version 3); nothing is taken away.
